items.t: Engine stalls from failing fuel pump (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump under recall

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pumps under recall

items.t: Brake assist and stability control can shut off (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake booster pump under recall
items.note: Outside the recall, a brake booster replacement is an expensive repair; ask for a written quote.

items.t: Backup camera image shows up late (recall)
items.job: Update parking-assist computer software under recall

items.t: Door handle stays out or door won't open
items.job: Replace outside door handle and actuator assembly
items.note: One owner paid about $470 for an imported handle and did it himself; a dealer part costs more. YourMechanic prices a front door lock actuator job at about $386–$516.

items.t: Brakes squeal or squeak
items.job: Replace pads with Lexus alternative low-noise pads (one axle)
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $330–$350 per axle for LC 500 pads; dealers charge about $370–$510.

items.t: Squawk or knock from the engine bay when braking
items.job: Diagnose and repair per Lexus bulletin L-SB-0006-21
items.note: Usually covered while the car is under warranty.

items.t: Spring noise when lifting off the gas pedal
items.job: Repair accelerator pedal noise per Lexus bulletin

items.t: Electric parking brake warning message
items.job: Diagnose and repair electric parking brake actuator
items.note: Cost depends on whether the bulletin repair or a new actuator is needed.

items.t: Low oil warning when the oil level is fine
items.job: Repair false low-oil alert per Lexus bulletin

items.t: Navigation freezes, goes black or resets
items.job: Navigation software update

items.t: Rattle from the high-mounted brake light
items.job: Repair or replace high-mount stop lamp

items.t: Uneven A/C airflow or vents won't switch
items.job: Diagnose and repair climate air-door servo motors
items.note: RepairPal estimates a blower motor job on the LC 500 at about $525–$568 if that turns out to be the fault.

items.t: Water pump coolant leak
items.job: Replace engine water pump and coolant
items.note: Labor varies a lot by engine; get a written quote.

items.t: Hybrid system warning in freezing weather
items.job: Repair high-voltage circuit fault per Lexus bulletin LSB005523
items.note: Usually covered under Lexus hybrid component warranty.

items.t: Hard starting with lean check engine codes
items.job: Diagnose low fuel pressure and repair per Lexus bulletin
items.note: If the in-tank pump is the cause and the recall applies, the pump is free.

items.t: Musty smell after water gets inside
items.job: Fix water leak, dry and treat interior

items.t: Water on the floor from a blocked A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C drain hose and fit bug-resistant tip

items.t: A/C blows warm from a refrigerant leak
items.job: Find refrigerant leak with dye, repair and recharge
items.note: RepairPal estimates an LC 500 A/C recharge alone at about $320–$419; the leak repair is extra.

items.t: Lurching or clunky shifts at low speed
items.job: Check for and install transmission software updates
items.note: Many dealers report no fault found; cost is mainly diagnostic time.

items.t: Convertible top leaks or lets light in at the pillar
items.job: Adjust soft top and realign pillar seal

items.t: Car pulls to one side or steering wheel off center
items.job: Tire check and swap, then four-wheel alignment if needed

items.t: Shift lever knob works loose
items.job: Tighten shift knob
items.note: Owners fix this by hand-tightening the knob clockwise.
